rework_notes: Spec-level acceptance rejected the landing (contract, definition-of-done) and rerouted to PBI_PLANNING. In cards.py, list_cards uses offset-based .range() pagination over separate active-card queries: if a card from an earlier page is soft-deleted between queries, subsequent offsets skip an unchanged active card. Canvas._show only replays notifications, so the deletion notification cannot recover that skipped card, violating the Contract's loss-free subscription-before-snapshot loading requirement. The requirement to load persisted, non-deleted cards is not genuinely satisfied under concurrent soft-deletion during paginated loading: an active card can be omitted indefinitely from the opening canvas. The added pagination tests cover static datasets, not this shifting-page case. The Contract already correctly requires loading persisted active cards and reconciling changes during loading without loss. This is a code-level pagination/reconciliation gap requiring an integration PBI, not a change to the Contract.
